extends Node3D
## Ghost Company — Interactive Asset Showcase v3.2 "Real Game Scene" (runtime-assembled)
## Bible: godot-dev-bible §3 (controller/camera), §6 (pitfalls), §9 (audio), §10 (3D),
## §11 (anim) + mega-bible Part 4 (feel).
## v3.2: Sky3D plugin (real sun/moon/stars/clouds, 20-min day cycle, started at 21:30)
## · rolling terrain w/ trimesh collider · full nature kit (pines, rocks, plants, petals)
## · exhibit offset sanity clamp (fixes the grey orbiting object).
## Controls: WASD move · Shift run · mouse look · wheel zoom · ESC mouse/slider ·
##           T toon · N/M track prev/next · [ / ] volume keys (slider mirrors)

const PLAYER_GLB := "res://assets/quaternius/KayKit-Character-Pack-Skeletons-1.0-15b62b9bad122f72926c10fb14d622c73819fa54/addons/kaykit_character_pack_skeletons/Characters/gltf/Skeleton_Warrior.glb"
const FACING_FIX := 0.0
const PLAYER_LIFT := 0.0
const TOON_MAT := "res://materials/seance_toon.tres"
const RING_RADIUS := 13.0
const SPEED_WALK := 3.2
const SPEED_RUN := 6.5
const GRAV := 25.0
const TERMINAL := -40.0
const ACCEL := 14.0
const CAM_MIN_LEN := 1.6
const CAM_MAX_LEN := 28.0
const CAM_PITCH_MIN := -1.25
const CAM_PITCH_MAX := 1.52
const SENS := 0.003
const ZOOM_K := 14.0
const SPIN_SPEED := 0.35
const BOUND := 30.0
const MUSIC_DIR := "res://assets/audio/music"
const VOL_MIN_DB := -40.0
const VOL_MAX_DB := 0.0
const VOL_STEP_DB := 2.0
const SCATTER_SEED := 7
## --- Sky3D (Compatibility renderer: README says contribution 0.75, fog 0.01) ---
const SKY3D_SCRIPT := "res://addons/sky_3d/src/Sky3D.gd"
const SKY_START_TIME := 21.5   ## séance night — moon + stars up
const SKY_MINUTES_PER_DAY := 20.0  ## full day/night cycle per 20 real minutes
## --- terrain ---
const TERRAIN_SIZE := 130.0
const TERRAIN_SUBDIV := 96
const FLAT_RADIUS := 17.0     ## perfectly flat inside this (gallery + plaza)
const FADE_RADIUS := 7.0      ## hills ramp up from FLAT_RADIUS to FLAT_RADIUS+this
const MAX_OFFSET := 3.0       ## exhibit centering sanity clamp (grey-orbit bug fix)

var player: CharacterBody3D
var model_wrapper: Node3D
var cam_yaw_pivot: Node3D
var cam_arm: SpringArm3D
var player_anim: AnimationPlayer
var idle_name := ""
var walk_name := ""
var run_name := ""
var spin_wrappers: Array = []
var pinned_exhibits: Array = []
var exhibits: Array = []
var toon_on := false
var toon_mat: Material
var cam_yaw := PI
var cam_pitch := 0.22
var cam_len_target := 4.5
var music_player: AudioStreamPlayer
var playlist: Array = []
var track_index := -1
var music_vol_db := -8.0
var music_label: Label
var volume_slider: HSlider
var sky3d: Node3D

func _ready() -> void:
	print("[showcase] boot v3.2")
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
	toon_mat = load(TOON_MAT) as Material
	_build_world()
	_build_gallery()
	_build_environment()
	_build_player()
	_build_ui()
	_setup_music()
	print("[showcase] READY — exhibits: ", exhibits.size(), " · tracks: ", playlist.size())

## deterministic heightfield — same function drives the mesh, the collider,
## and where props/trees get planted, so nothing floats or sinks
func terrain_height(x: float, z: float) -> float:
	var d := sqrt(x * x + z * z)
	var fade := clampf((d - FLAT_RADIUS) / FADE_RADIUS, 0.0, 1.0)
	fade = fade * fade * (3.0 - 2.0 * fade)  ## smoothstep
	var h := 0.0
	h += sin(x * 0.11 + 1.7) * cos(z * 0.09 - 0.6) * 1.6
	h += sin(x * 0.031 - 0.4) * sin(z * 0.027 + 2.1) * 2.2
	h += sin((x + z) * 0.16 + 3.0) * 0.45
	return maxf(h, 0.0) * fade  ## only gentle rises — no dips below the floor

func _build_world() -> void:
	## --- rolling terrain: displaced plane + recomputed normals + trimesh shape ---
	var pm := PlaneMesh.new()
	pm.size = Vector2(TERRAIN_SIZE, TERRAIN_SIZE)
	pm.subdivide_width = TERRAIN_SUBDIV
	pm.subdivide_depth = TERRAIN_SUBDIV
	var arrays := pm.surface_get_arrays(0)
	var verts: PackedVector3Array = arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
	for i in range(verts.size()):
		var v: Vector3 = verts[i]
		verts[i] = Vector3(v.x, terrain_height(v.x, v.z), v.z)
	arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = verts
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.create_from_arrays(arrays, Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	st.generate_normals()
	var terrain_mesh: ArrayMesh = st.commit()
	var floor_mesh := MeshInstance3D.new()
	floor_mesh.mesh = terrain_mesh
	var fm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	fm.albedo_color = Color(0.10, 0.15, 0.09)
	fm.roughness = 1.0
	floor_mesh.material_override = fm
	add_child(floor_mesh)
	var floor_body := StaticBody3D.new()
	floor_body.collision_layer = 1
	add_child(floor_body)
	var floor_col := CollisionShape3D.new()
	floor_col.shape = terrain_mesh.create_trimesh_shape()
	floor_body.add_child(floor_col)
	## --- stone plaza disc under the gallery ---
	var plaza := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var pd := CylinderMesh.new()
	pd.top_radius = 15.6
	pd.bottom_radius = 15.6
	pd.height = 0.04
	plaza.mesh = pd
	plaza.position = Vector3(0, 0.02, 0)
	var pm2 := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	pm2.albedo_color = Color(0.09, 0.10, 0.12)
	pm2.roughness = 1.0
	plaza.material_override = pm2
	add_child(plaza)
	## invisible boundary walls — LAYER 2 so the camera never snaps on them
	for i in range(4):
		var wall := StaticBody3D.new()
		wall.collision_layer = 2
		add_child(wall)
		var wc := CollisionShape3D.new()
		var wb := BoxShape3D.new()
		wb.size = Vector3(BOUND * 2.0 + 8.0, 12.0, 1.0)
		wc.shape = wb
		var ang := PI * 0.5 * float(i)
		wc.position = Vector3(sin(ang), 6.0, cos(ang)) * (BOUND + 0.5)
		wall.rotation.y = ang
		wall.add_child(wc)
	## --- Sky3D: replaces the hand-rolled sky. Adds real sun, moon, stars,
	## clouds, atmospheric fog, and a full day/night cycle (Alex's plugin). ---
	sky3d = load(SKY3D_SCRIPT).new()
	add_child(sky3d)
	sky3d.current_time = SKY_START_TIME
	sky3d.minutes_per_day = SKY_MINUTES_PER_DAY
	sky3d.sky_contribution = 0.75  ## Compatibility renderer per Sky3D README
	sky3d.moon_energy = 0.4
	sky3d.sun_energy = 1.0
	if sky3d.get("sky") and sky3d.sky:
		if "fog_density" in sky3d.sky:
			sky3d.sky.fog_density = 0.01  ## Compatibility renderer per Sky3D README
	print("[showcase] Sky3D day/night cycle armed — starts 21:30, ", SKY_MINUTES_PER_DAY, " min/day")
	## séance lights stay — the gallery keeps its spectral cyan mood
	var seance := OmniLight3D.new()
	seance.position = Vector3(0, 4, 0)
	seance.omni_range = 22
	seance.light_energy = 3.0
	seance.light_color = Color(0.45, 0.8, 1.0)
	add_child(seance)

func _gallery_entries() -> Array:
	var entries := [
		["Ghost · Ultimate Monsters", "res://assets/quaternius/Ghost.glb"],
		["Ghost Skull", "res://assets/quaternius/Ghost Skull.glb"],
		["Imp · Bestiary (emissive)", "res://assets/quaternius/Bestiary - Dungeon Monsters Kit[Standard]/Exports/GLB (Godot-Unreal)/Imp.glb"],
		["Puglin · Bestiary", "res://assets/quaternius/Bestiary - Dungeon Monsters Kit[Standard]/Exports/GLB (Godot-Unreal)/Puglin.glb"],
		["Skeleton Mage · KayKit", "res://assets/quaternius/KayKit-Character-Pack-Skeletons-1.0-15b62b9bad122f72926c10fb14d622c73819fa54/addons/kaykit_character_pack_skeletons/Characters/gltf/Skeleton_Mage.glb"],
		["Skeleton Rogue · KayKit", "res://assets/quaternius/KayKit-Character-Pack-Skeletons-1.0-15b62b9bad122f72926c10fb14d622c73819fa54/addons/kaykit_character_pack_skeletons/Characters/gltf/Skeleton_Rogue.glb"],
		["Skeleton Minion · KayKit", "res://assets/quaternius/KayKit-Character-Pack-Skeletons-1.0-15b62b9bad122f72926c10fb14d622c73819fa54/addons/kaykit_character_pack_skeletons/Characters/gltf/Skeleton_Minion.glb"],
		["Orc Enemy · Monsters", "res://assets/quaternius/Orc Enemy.glb"],
		["Dragon · Monsters", "res://assets/quaternius/Dragon.glb"],
		["Yeti · Monsters", "res://assets/quaternius/Yeti.glb"],
		["Mushroom King · Monsters", "res://assets/quaternius/Mushroom King.glb"],
		["Ninja · Monsters", "res://assets/quaternius/Ninja.glb"],
		["Wizard · Monsters", "res://assets/quaternius/Wizard.glb"],
		["Cauldron · prop", "res://assets/exports/glTF/Cauldron.gltf"],
		["Bookcase · prop", "res://assets/exports/glTF/Bookcase_2.gltf"],
		["Candles · prop", "res://assets/exports/glTF/CandleStick_Triple.gltf"],
		["Banner · prop", "res://assets/exports/glTF/Banner_1.gltf"],
		["Barrel · prop", "res://assets/exports/glTF/Barrel.gltf"],
		["Twisted Tree · environment", "res://assets/gltf/TwistedTree_2.gltf"],
	]
	var wall_files := _dir_files("res://assets/gltf/Walls")
	if wall_files.size() > 0:
		entries.append(["Wall piece · sci-fi kit", "res://assets/gltf/Walls/" + wall_files[0]])
	var aliens := _dir_files("res://assets/gltf/Aliens")
	if aliens.size() > 0:
		entries.append(["Alien · alternates", "res://assets/gltf/Aliens/" + aliens[0]])
	return entries

func _dir_files(dir_path: String) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	var files := DirAccess.get_files_at(dir_path)
	for f in files:
		if String(f).ends_with(".glb") or String(f).ends_with(".gltf"):
			out.append(String(f))
	out.sort()
	return out

func _build_gallery() -> void:
	var entries := _gallery_entries()
	var n := entries.size()
	for i in range(n):
		var label: String = String(entries[i][0])
		var path: String = String(entries[i][1])
		var angle := TAU * float(i) / float(n)
		var pos := Vector3(sin(angle) * RING_RADIUS, 0, cos(angle) * RING_RADIUS)
		var pedestal := MeshInstance3D.new()
		var cyl := CylinderMesh.new()
		cyl.top_radius = 1.1
		cyl.bottom_radius = 1.3
		cyl.height = 0.35
		pedestal.mesh = cyl
		pedestal.position = pos + Vector3(0, 0.175, 0)
		var pmm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		pmm.albedo_color = Color(0.10, 0.12, 0.18)
		pmm.roughness = 1.0
		pedestal.material_override = pmm
		add_child(pedestal)
		var pbody := StaticBody3D.new()
		pbody.collision_layer = 2
		pbody.position = pos + Vector3(0, 0.175, 0)
		add_child(pbody)
		var pcol := CollisionShape3D.new()
		var pcyl := CylinderShape3D.new()
		pcyl.radius = 1.25
		pcyl.height = 0.35
		pcol.shape = pcyl
		pbody.add_child(pcol)
		var lb := Label3D.new()
		lb.text = label
		lb.font_size = 40
		lb.billboard = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
		lb.modulate = Color(0.7, 0.9, 1.0)
		lb.position = pos + Vector3(0, 3.0, 0)
		add_child(lb)
		var scene := load(path) as PackedScene
		if scene == null:
			print("[showcase] MISSING: ", path)
			continue
		var wrapper := Node3D.new()
		wrapper.position = pos + Vector3(0, 0.35, 0)
		add_child(wrapper)
		var inst := scene.instantiate()
		wrapper.add_child(inst)
		var aabb := _combined_aabb(inst)
		var height := aabb.size.y
		if height > 2.4:
			wrapper.scale = Vector3.ONE * (2.4 / height)
		elif height > 0.0 and height < 0.8:
			wrapper.scale = Vector3.ONE * (1.2 / height)
		aabb = _combined_aabb(inst)
		var s := wrapper.scale.x
		var center := aabb.get_center()
		var offset := Vector3(
			(wrapper.global_position.x - center.x) / s,
			(0.35 - aabb.position.y) / s,
			(wrapper.global_position.z - center.z) / s
		)
		## v3.2 SANITY CLAMP: a lying AABB pins the model at a huge offset, and the
		## spinning wrapper then turns that offset into an endless ORBIT — the
		## "large grey object in the distance that moves constantly". If the computed
		## centering offset is absurd, zero the horizontal part and say so.
		if Vector2(offset.x, offset.z).length() > MAX_OFFSET:
			print("[showcase] SUSPECT AABB on '", label, "' (offset ", offset, ") — clamped to pedestal center")
			offset.x = 0.0
			offset.z = 0.0
		inst.position = offset
		pinned_exhibits.append([inst, offset])
		spin_wrappers.append(wrapper)
		exhibits.append(wrapper)
		var ap := _find_anim_player(inst)
		if ap:
			var picked := ""
			for anim_name in ap.get_animation_list():
				var l := String(anim_name).to_lower()
				if "idle" in l:
					picked = String(anim_name)
					break
			if picked != "":
				ap.play(picked)
		var pl := OmniLight3D.new()
		pl.position = pos + Vector3(0, 3.0, 0)
		pl.omni_range = 5
		pl.light_energy = 1.2
		pl.light_color = Color(0.55, 0.85, 1.0)
		add_child(pl)

func _build_environment() -> void:
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = SCATTER_SEED
	var tree_paths := [
		"res://assets/gltf/CommonTree_1.gltf", "res://assets/gltf/CommonTree_3.gltf",
		"res://assets/gltf/CommonTree_5.gltf", "res://assets/gltf/DeadTree_2.gltf",
		"res://assets/gltf/DeadTree_4.gltf", "res://assets/gltf/TwistedTree_3.gltf",
		"res://assets/gltf/TwistedTree_4.gltf", "res://assets/gltf/TwistedTree_5.gltf",
		"res://assets/quaternius/Stylized-Nature-Kit/glTF/Pine_2.gltf",
		"res://assets/quaternius/Stylized-Nature-Kit/glTF/Pine_4.gltf",
	]
	for i in range(16):
		var path: String = tree_paths[i % tree_paths.size()]
		var scene := load(path) as PackedScene
		if scene == null:
			continue
		var ang := TAU * float(i) / 16.0 + rng.randf_range(-0.12, 0.12)
		var rad := rng.randf_range(21.0, 28.5)
		var p := Vector3(sin(ang) * rad, 0, cos(ang) * rad)
		p.y = terrain_height(p.x, p.z)
		var inst := scene.instantiate()
		var holder := Node3D.new()
		holder.position = p
		holder.rotation.y = rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)
		var sc := rng.randf_range(1.1, 1.7)
		holder.scale = Vector3.ONE * sc
		holder.add_child(inst)
		add_child(holder)
		var tb := StaticBody3D.new()
		tb.collision_layer = 2
		holder.add_child(tb)
		var tc := CollisionShape3D.new()
		var cyl := CylinderShape3D.new()
		cyl.radius = 0.45
		cyl.height = 4.0
		tc.shape = cyl
		tc.position = Vector3(0, 2.0, 0)
		tb.add_child(tc)
	## big rocks from the new kit — anchor pieces of the field
	var rock_paths := [
		"res://assets/quaternius/Stylized-Nature-Kit/glTF/Rock_Medium_1.gltf",
		"res://assets/quaternius/Stylized-Nature-Kit/glTF/Rock_Medium_2.gltf",
		"res://assets/quaternius/Stylized-Nature-Kit/glTF/Rock_Medium_3.gltf",
	]
	for i in range(10):
		var path: String = rock_paths[i % rock_paths.size()]
		var scene := load(path) as PackedScene
		if scene == null:
			continue
		var ang := rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)
		var rad := rng.randf_range(18.5, 27.0)
		var p := Vector3(sin(ang) * rad, 0, cos(ang) * rad)
		p.y = terrain_height(p.x, p.z) - 0.2  ## sink slightly, looks anchored
		var inst := scene.instantiate()
		var holder := Node3D.new()
		holder.position = p
		holder.rotation.y = rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)
		holder.scale = Vector3.ONE * rng.randf_range(0.9, 1.6)
		holder.add_child(inst)
		add_child(holder)
	## ground cover: grasses from the old kit + plants/petals from the new kit
	var prop_paths := [
		"res://assets/gltf/Grass_Common_Short.gltf", "res://assets/gltf/Grass_Common_Tall.gltf",
		"res://assets/gltf/Grass_Wispy_Short.gltf", "res://assets/gltf/Grass_Wispy_Tall.gltf",
		"res://assets/gltf/Clover_1.gltf", "res://assets/gltf/Clover_2.gltf",
		"res://assets/gltf/Fern_1.gltf", "res://assets/gltf/Bush_Common.gltf",
		"res://assets/gltf/Bush_Common_Flowers.gltf", "res://assets/gltf/Flower_3_Group.gltf",
		"res://assets/gltf/Flower_4_Group.gltf", "res://assets/gltf/Mushroom_Common.gltf",
		"res://assets/gltf/Mushroom_Laetiporus.gltf", "res://assets/gltf/Pebble_Round_1.gltf",
		"res://assets/gltf/Pebble_Round_3.gltf", "res://assets/gltf/Pebble_Square_2.gltf",
		"res://assets/quaternius/Stylized-Nature-Kit/glTF/Plant_1.gltf",
		"res://assets/quaternius/Stylized-Nature-Kit/glTF/Plant_7.gltf",
		"res://assets/quaternius/Stylized-Nature-Kit/glTF/Plant_1_Big.gltf",
		"res://assets/quaternius/Stylized-Nature-Kit/glTF/Petal_1.gltf",
		"res://assets/quaternius/Stylized-Nature-Kit/glTF/Petal_3.gltf",
	]
	var loaded_props: Array = []
	for p in prop_paths:
		var ps := load(String(p)) as PackedScene
		if ps:
			loaded_props.append(ps)
	for i in range(220):
		if loaded_props.size() == 0:
			break
		var ps: PackedScene = loaded_props[rng.randi_range(0, loaded_props.size() - 1)]
		var ang := rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)
		var rad := rng.randf_range(16.2, 33.0)
		var p := Vector3(sin(ang) * rad, 0, cos(ang) * rad)
		p.y = terrain_height(p.x, p.z)
		var inst := ps.instantiate()
		var holder := Node3D.new()
		holder.position = p
		holder.rotation.y = rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)
		holder.scale = Vector3.ONE * rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.5)
		holder.add_child(inst)
		add_child(holder)

func _combined_aabb(node: Node) -> AABB:
	var aabb := AABB()
	var first := true
	for child in node.get_children():
		if child is MeshInstance3D:
			var mi := child as MeshInstance3D
			var ba: AABB = mi.global_transform * mi.get_aabb()
			if first:
				aabb = ba
				first = false
			else:
				aabb = aabb.merge(ba)
		var sub := _combined_aabb(child)
		if not sub.has_volume():
			continue
		if first:
			aabb = sub
			first = false
		else:
			aabb = aabb.merge(sub)
	return aabb

func _find_anim_player(node: Node) -> AnimationPlayer:
	if node is AnimationPlayer:
		return node as AnimationPlayer
	for child in node.get_children():
		var res := _find_anim_player(child)
		if res:
			return res
	return null

func _build_player() -> void:
	player = CharacterBody3D.new()
	player.collision_layer = 1
	player.collision_mask = 3
	add_child(player)
	player.position = Vector3(0, 1.2, 6)
	var pcol := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var capsule := CapsuleShape3D.new()
	capsule.height = 1.8
	capsule.radius = 0.35
	pcol.shape = capsule
	pcol.position = Vector3(0, 0.9, 0)
	player.add_child(pcol)
	model_wrapper = Node3D.new()
	model_wrapper.rotation.y = FACING_FIX
	player.add_child(model_wrapper)
	var scene := load(PLAYER_GLB) as PackedScene
	if scene == null:
		print("[showcase] MISSING PLAYER: ", PLAYER_GLB)
		return
	var inst := scene.instantiate()
	model_wrapper.add_child(inst)
	inst.position.y = PLAYER_LIFT
	player_anim = _find_anim_player(inst)
	if player_anim:
		for anim_name in player_anim.get_animation_list():
			var l := String(anim_name).to_lower()
			if "idle" in l and idle_name == "":
				idle_name = String(anim_name)
			elif "walk" in l and walk_name == "":
				walk_name = String(anim_name)
			elif "run" in l and run_name == "":
				run_name = String(anim_name)
		if walk_name == "":
			walk_name = idle_name
		if run_name == "":
			run_name = walk_name
		if idle_name != "":
			player_anim.play(idle_name, 0.2)
	## bible §3: yaw pivot -> SpringArm3D (pitch) -> camera (collision layer 1 only)
	cam_yaw_pivot = Node3D.new()
	cam_yaw_pivot.position = Vector3(0, 1.5, 0)
	player.add_child(cam_yaw_pivot)
	cam_arm = SpringArm3D.new()
	cam_arm.spring_length = 4.5
	cam_arm.collision_mask = 1
	cam_arm.margin = 0.3
	cam_arm.add_excluded_object(player.get_rid())
	cam_yaw_pivot.add_child(cam_arm)
	var cam := Camera3D.new()
	cam.fov = 60.0
	cam.current = true
	cam.far = 6000.0  ## Sky3D's dome is huge — must not clip the sky
	cam_arm.add_child(cam)
	cam_yaw_pivot.rotation = Vector3(0.0, cam_yaw, 0.0)
	cam_arm.rotation.x = cam_pitch

func _build_ui() -> void:
	var ui := CanvasLayer.new()
	add_child(ui)
	var lb := Label.new()
	lb.text = "GHOST COMPANY — ASSET SHOWCASE
WASD move · Shift run · mouse look · wheel zoom · ESC mouse · T toon
N / M music prev / next · [ / ] volume keys — or the slider below (ESC to use it)"
	lb.position = Vector2(16, 12)
	lb.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)

	music_label.position = Vector2(16, 108)
	music_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)
	music_label.modulate = Color(0.65, 0.85, 0.75)
	ui.add_child(music_label)
	var vol_caption := Label.new()
	vol_caption.text = "♪ Music volume (dB)"
	vol_caption.position = Vector2(16, 136)
	vol_caption.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)

	volume_slider.max_value = VOL_MAX_DB

	volume_slider.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(240, 20)

func _setup_music() -> void:
	playlist = []
	_scan_music_dir(MUSIC_DIR)
	playlist.sort()
	print("[showcase] playlist: ", playlist.size(), " tracks")
	music_player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	music_player.bus = "Master"
	add_child(music_player)
	music_player.volume_db = music_vol_db
	if playlist.size() > 0:
		_play_track(0)

func _scan_music_dir(dir_path: String) -> void:
	var dir := DirAccess.open(dir_path)
	if dir == null:
		return
	dir.list_dir_begin()
	var fname := dir.get_next()
	while fname != "":
		var full := dir_path + "/" + String(fname)
		if dir.current_is_dir() and not String(fname).begins_with("."):
			_scan_music_dir(full)
		else:
			var low := String(fname).to_lower()
			if low.ends_with(".wav") or low.ends_with(".ogg"):
				playlist.append(full)
		fname = dir.get_next()
	dir.list_dir_end()

func _play_track(index: int) -> void:
	if playlist.size() == 0:
		return
	track_index = index
	var path: String = String(playlist[track_index])
	var stream := load(path) as AudioStream
	if stream == null:
		print("[showcase] music missing: ", path)
		return
	music_player.stream = stream
	music_player.volume_db = music_vol_db
	music_player.play()
	_update_music_label()
	print("[showcase] music: ", path.get_file())

func _track_display() -> String:
	if track_index < 0 or track_index >= playlist.size():
		return "no tracks"
	var p: String = String(playlist[track_index])
	var folder := p.get_slice("/", p.get_slice_count("/") - 2)
	return "(%d/%d) %s — %s" % [track_index + 1, playlist.size(), folder, p.get_file().get_basename()]

func _update_music_label() -> void:
	if music_label:
		music_label.text = "%s\nVolume: %.0f dB %s" % [
			_track_display(), music_vol_db,
			"(muted)" if music_vol_db <= VOL_MIN_DB else ""]

func _on_volume_slider(value: float) -> void:
	music_vol_db = clampf(value, VOL_MIN_DB, VOL_MAX_DB)
	if music_player:
		music_player.volume_db = music_vol_db
	_update_music_label()

func _next_track(dir_: int) -> void:
	if playlist.size() == 0:
		return
	_play_track(wrapi(track_index + dir_, 0, playlist.size()))

func _nudge_volume(delta_db: float) -> void:
	music_vol_db = clampf(music_vol_db + delta_db, VOL_MIN_DB, VOL_MAX_DB)
	if music_player:
		music_player.volume_db = music_vol_db
	if volume_slider:
		volume_slider.value = music_vol_db
	_update_music_label()

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseMotion and Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
		cam_yaw -= event.relative.x * SENS
		cam_pitch = clamp(cam_pitch + event.relative.y * SENS, CAM_PITCH_MIN, CAM_PITCH_MAX)
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
		if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
			var step := clampf(cam_len_target * 0.12, 0.35, 3.0)
			cam_len_target = clamp(cam_len_target - step, CAM_MIN_LEN, CAM_MAX_LEN)
		elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
			var step := clampf(cam_len_target * 0.12, 0.35, 3.0)
			cam_len_target = clamp(cam_len_target + step, CAM_MIN_LEN, CAM_MAX_LEN)
		elif Input.mouse_mode != Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
			Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
	elif event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
		if Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
			Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE
		else:
			Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
	elif event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
		match event.keycode:
			KEY_T:
				_toggle_toon()
			KEY_M:
				_next_track(1)
			KEY_N:
				_next_track(-1)
			KEY_BRACKETLEFT:
				_nudge_volume(-VOL_STEP_DB)
			KEY_BRACKETRIGHT:
				_nudge_volume(VOL_STEP_DB)

func _toggle_toon() -> void:
	toon_on = not toon_on
	print("[showcase] toon shader ", "ON" if toon_on else "OFF")
	var targets: Array = exhibits.duplicate()
	targets.append(model_wrapper)
	for wrapper in targets:
		_apply_override(wrapper, toon_mat if toon_on else null)

func _apply_override(node: Node, mat: Material) -> void:
	if node is MeshInstance3D:
		(node as MeshInstance3D).material_override = mat
	for child in node.get_children():
		_apply_override(child, mat)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not player:
		return
	var move_input := Vector2(
		(1.0 if Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_D) else 0.0) - (1.0 if Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_A) else 0.0),
		(1.0 if Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_S) else 0.0) - (1.0 if Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_W) else 0.0)
	)
	var run_now := Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT)
	var speed := SPEED_RUN if run_now else SPEED_WALK
	var target := Vector3.ZERO
	if move_input != Vector2.ZERO:
		var b := cam_yaw_pivot.global_transform.basis
		target = b * Vector3(move_input.x, 0.0, move_input.y)
		target.y = 0.0
		target = target.normalized() * speed
	var k := 1.0 - exp(-ACCEL * delta)
	player.velocity.x = lerpf(player.velocity.x, target.x, k)
	player.velocity.z = lerpf(player.velocity.z, target.z, k)
	player.velocity.y = maxf(player.velocity.y - GRAV * delta, TERMINAL)
	player.move_and_slide()
	var moving := move_input != Vector2.ZERO
	if moving:
		var face := atan2(target.x, target.z) + FACING_FIX
		model_wrapper.rotation.y = lerp_angle(model_wrapper.rotation.y, face, 12.0 * delta)
	if player_anim:
		var want := idle_name
		if moving:
			want = run_name if run_now else walk_name
		if want != "" and player_anim.current_animation != StringName(want):
			player_anim.play(want, 0.2)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if cam_yaw_pivot:
		cam_yaw_pivot.rotation.y = cam_yaw
	if cam_arm:
		cam_arm.rotation.x = cam_pitch
		var k := 1.0 - exp(-ZOOM_K * delta)
		cam_arm.spring_length = lerpf(cam_arm.spring_length, cam_len_target, k)
	for wrapper in spin_wrappers:
		wrapper.rotation.y += SPIN_SPEED * delta
	for pin in pinned_exhibits:
		var inst: Node3D = pin[0]
		inst.position = pin[1]
